TOP: Roundcube SQL injection under active exploitation
Vercel KVM zero-day breaks the Firecracker sandbox
Apple locks down Full Disk Access against AI agents

P.h: Vercel confirms KVM zero-day escape from its Firecracker sandbox
P.p: A KVM flaw reported by researcher Paulos Yibelo reportedly let guest code reach root on the host, breaking the microVM boundary Vercel Sandbox uses to isolate untrusted workloads and AI agents. Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch confirmed the bug and the $50,000 maximum bounty.
P.s: No CVE, affected kernel versions, exploit chain or patch are public yet. Anyone relying on KVM for multi-tenant isolation should watch for Vercel's write-up and Linux vendor advisories, and should not assume the unrelated Januscape fix covers it.

items.h: Roundcube pre-auth SQL injection under active exploitation
items.d: CVE-2026-48842 in the virtuser_query plugin hits versions 1.6.0 to 1.6.15 and 1.7.0. Update to 1.6.16 or 1.7.1, or disable the plugin.

items.h: Citrix patches exploited NetScaler SAML zero-day
items.d: CVE-2026-88779 fixed in 14.1-73.41 and 13.1-64.28. A patched honeypot was seen running malware. Admins also report auth daemon reboot loops.

items.h: 543,699 live credentials found in public GitHub repos
items.d: Median exposure was 784 days. Push protection missed connection strings, private keys and Google API keys. 69,041 Google Cloud credentials still work.

items.h: Bouncy Castle flaw lets attackers spoof MLS group members
items.d: CVE-2026-71885 breaks certificate binding for agent-to-agent channels in Java versions before 1.86. Upgrade to 1.86.

P.h: Agents now get guardrails from the OS and the cloud bill
P.p: Apple says macOS will require very explicit user action to grant Full Disk Access, citing autonomous AI agents as the reason. It is the first OS-level permission change aimed at agent risk, and follows the disputed report of Meta's Muse reading Messages and a ChatGPT Mac app flaw.
P.s: On the cost side, AWS added a monthly spend limit that pauses projects, and Google Cloud launched Spend Caps. Simon Willison argues for default hard budget caps on everything.

Okta XAA passes 25 partners via TrueFoundry's AI gateway. IBM watsonx Orchestrate now manages Google, Microsoft and AWS agents with per-agent identity.

P.h: Cloudflare Traces follows a request through the whole platform
P.p: Cloudflare Traces is in open beta and extends automatic tracing beyond Workers to the rest of the request path. One trace shows security rules, transformations, cache decisions and origin handling, with no special configuration or plugins.
P.s: It supports OpenTelemetry and lets you set sampling rates or trace 100% of chosen traffic with Trace Rules. Cloudflare also added a Web Search API to AI Gateway via Ceramic.ai, Exa and Linkup.
